title: Create and Devastate
description: my other modpack used valkyrien skies but then create aeronautics came out so i have to change it. I think this is for the better
body:
This modpack was made to have fun and build planes at first but it slowly grew to an idea where it could be possible to simulate eras of war throught the past 100 years or so.

In this pack you could make early tanks thats are made to take out simple targets or tanks made to withstand a heavy attack of custom bomber planes.

You could if you wanted to make cars made to be as fast as possible.

If thats not what you're into though you could make boats made to take waves after waves of attacks from planes or other near by boats.

The possibilitys are endless with the machines you could make.
